subsection.name: Introduction
subsection.p: This plugin allows you to set up an application Healthcheck REST service.
This healthcheck service implements eclipse / microprofile-health API.
Several types of checks can be performed

subsection.name: Configuration
subsection.p: The server provides the MicroProfile Health API: Open Liberty needs the mpHealth-4.0 feature.

A health check is a CDI bean implementing org.eclipse.microprofile.health.HealthCheck, annotated @Readiness or @Liveness and @ApplicationScoped. The checks of every plugin are run. The server's own /health endpoint runs them too.
While the module rest-healthcheck is disabled, no check runs and the service answers 503.

ul.li: Forced state for the instance stored in the DATASTORE table. The key is "Health", prefixed with the instance name and a dot when the lutece.webapp.instance property is set. Value must be "UP" (or missing) or "DOWN".

subsection.name: Usage
subsection.p: The returned result will have a status of 200 (OK) or 503 (service unavailable) if at least one test fails.
